content.title: About
content.content: The Butterscotch Brownie Cookie is a soft, aromatic cookie featuring a rich buttery toffee flavor and chunks of chocolate brownie. The dough is made from wheat flour, butter, sugar, and eggs, then folded with butterscotch caramel pieces and bite‑size brownie bits that create a moist, flavorful center.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The butterscotch‑brownie combination was first introduced in 2015 by a craft bakery in San Francisco.
The cookie has a slightly crisp edge and a chewy, almost cake‑like interior.
Natural butterscotch syrup, free of artificial flavors, is used to achieve the signature caramel taste.
Each batch is lightly dusted with sea salt to accentuate the sweetness of the caramel.
The cookie is often paired with hot coffee or a milkshake for a balanced treat.

items.title: Energy source
items.content: Carbohydrates and a modest amount of fat provide quick energy for the body.

items.title: Contains iron
items.content: The chocolate brownie component supplies iron, which supports blood formation.

items.title: B‑vitamins
items.content: Eggs and whole‑grain flour contribute B1, B2, and B6 vitamins that aid metabolism.

items.title: Antioxidants
items.content: Cocoa in the brownie offers flavonoids that help combat free radicals.

items.title: Moderate sodium
items.content: A light sea‑salt topping enhances flavor without excessive sodium intake.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: The cookie contains wheat flour and is not suitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Sugar content
items.content: Butterscotch syrup and brownie pieces make the cookie sweet; those monitoring blood sugar should limit portions.

items.title: Nut and dairy allergies
items.content: Recipes may include nuts or dairy; check the ingredient list if you have related allergies.

items.title: Caloric density
items.content: Because of sugar and fat, the cookie is relatively calorie‑dense, so moderate consumption is advised.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the Butterscotch Brownie Cookie as a snack on its own, with tea or coffee, or crumble it over ice cream, yogurt, or desserts for added texture and flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the cookies in an airtight container at room temperature in a cool, dry place. For longer shelf life (over two weeks), keep them refrigerated to maintain a soft center.
